results.title: 'It’s bumpy, I'm emotional': Jaquie Brown on cancer treatment
results.description: Brown begins radiation therapy following a recent breast cancer diagnosis and mastectomy.

results.title: Toxic: 6 AM and 11.45 PM shows added in Mumbai amis increasing demand
results.description: Toxic is witnessing an overwhelming response with its advance bookings ahead of its release, with shows going houseful. Amid the surging demand, cinema halls in Mumbai have added 6 AM and 11.45 PM shows of the Yash-starrer
